transcript: Last night my boyfriend Paul and I saw The Cottage on Broadway. A light hearted comedy set in rural England, 1923. The story takes place in real time over the course of one eventful morning, where relationships and fidelity, or lack thereof, are revealed, and more secrets are exposed as the plan folds. This type of comedy is very tongue in cheek. The story itself is nothing groundbreaking, but the performances sell it, and the use of physicality is really fun too. We were also really impressed with the set design in the prop work, both of which had some really clever surprises that were funny as well. The cottage is playing a limited run through October 29th at the Hayes Theatre if you're interested with that. Another playbill for my collection.
